ai_assisted_development_policy.ai_code_review_focus: Intent + Assumption validation for Zero Trust JWT verification, D1 batch transactions, Durable Object inventory locks, and webhook idempotency replay safety.

slices.description: D1 migrations (0000 -> 0015) covering schema tables: orders, idempotency_keys, checkout_idempotency, landing_pages, landing_page_leads, failed_jobs, product_reviews, rma_requests.
Cloudflare Access Zero Trust JWT middleware (CF-Access-JWT-Assertion), RBAC role enforcement (superadmin, manager, support, editor), and local dev fallback header validation.
Stripe webhook event processing with lease-based idempotency state machine, signature verification, and Cloudflare Queue DLQ persistence before ack.
Public API checkout v2 logic using checkout_idempotency claim/replay, inventory reservation via INVENTORY_DO Durable Object & D1 batch locks.
Hybrid Lead & Order creation flow mapping Landing Pages with Product/Variants, Turnstile anti-spam, and real-time Stock Guard disabled state.
Telesale Admin UI tab for Landing Leads (1-click order approve/cancel, stock deduction), Order list Landing Page badge, and product-linking selector.
Cloudflare Cron Trigger (Worker) running daily to automatically delete idempotency_keys and abandoned checkout sessions older than 7 days based on created_at.
Implement ESLint boundaries (eslint-plugin-boundaries) in CI/CD to statically analyze and block cross-imports between public-api and admin-api trust zones.
Maintain standard TypeScript types (Zod schemas) in packages/contract workspace to guarantee type-safe RPC boundaries between Hono and UI apps.

progressive_delivery.canary_target: 100% storefront & admin traffic on main branch Cloudflare Workers/Pages
progressive_delivery.rollback_trigger: Checkout 5xx error rate > 1% OR Stripe webhook failure rate > 0% OR D1 lock contention timeout
progressive_delivery.observability_requirement: Log all inventory soft-lock collisions, Turnstile validation failures, and webhook idempotency lease states to Cloudflare Workers Logs & audit_logs table.
